name: What is an in-law suite addition and what does it typically include?

mainEntity.name: What is an in-law suite addition and what does it typically include?

acceptedAnswer.text: An in-law suite addition is a dedicated secondary living space built onto or within an existing home, designed for aging parents, extended family, or long-term guests. These spaces typically feature a private bedroom, a full or three-quarter bathroom, a sitting or living area, and often a kitchenette or small kitchen. Depending on the lot and existing layout, an in-law suite can be built as a ground-floor bump-out, a second-story extension, or tied into a converted basement remodel. Blue Lake Construction coordinates the framing, electrical, plumbing, and interior remodeling required to seamlessly connect the new addition with the rest of your primary residence.
acceptedAnswer.description: An in-law suite is an attached secondary living area featuring a private bedroom, bathroom, living space, and often a kitchenette to accommodate multi-generational living.
